faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut) for a project in the Department of Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in NIT Calicut recruitment?
faq.answer: The post offered in this recruitment drive is Research Assistant on a contract basis for an IIFPAR/CEFIPRA project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Assistant position at NIT Calicut.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech degree with a specialization in Artificial Intelligence, Electronics, Communications, Electrical, Computer Science, or related degrees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Assistant post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit to apply for this role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years, with age relaxations provided for reserved categories as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled application form along with required documents via email is 09-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The offline interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to take place on 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for NIT Calicut Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to send their scanned applications and supporting documents through email to the designated official email addresses.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application email be sent?
faq.answer: Candidates should send their consolidated PDF application to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] mentioning the appropriate subject line.
